releaseNotes: Moves website Premium purchases to Paddle Live with server-verified checkout notifications, transaction-based license activation, device limits, entitlement validation, and refund or chargeback revocation. Removes obsolete Lemon Squeezy configuration. Keeps Google Play Billing available as a separate in-app purchase option. Includes the combined 1.7–1.9 improvements: Premium Session Guard, device-reported refresh rates, Private DNS checks, settings restore points, expanded reset behavior, improved game profiles and overlays, AdMob, refreshed light/dark interface, and 13 app languages. Debug builds use Google demo ad units; release builds use ProjectZenith AdMob units and are subject to AdMob approval and serving status.
